why: Issue #617. A `{ playUntil }` step stops at the first visible `.hud-action` whatever ending it belongs to. Mission Clear and Game Over both show one, so a campaign-over capture whose autoplay happened to win would photograph Mission Clear under the Game Over id and pass.
killedBy: steps.mjs: advancePlay, the verdict of a played step fails when the game ends on the WRONG screen, quoting what it says instead
